### Words of the kinds of data

`DataKindWords` · `src/words.ts:13`

What the kinds the library carries say: their labels, the labels of their fields, what their holes say, what they render. The kinds are files of the language, outside the graph: their words are a catalog all the same, which they call; a kind writes no text of its own.

The messages are written in `./kinds/words.ts`.
